main.description: The entry point: its i32 is the process exit status.

function.description: A function with a block body; every path returns.

expression function.description: A function whose body is one expression.

view function.description: A function that borrows n elements; a call may leave n out.

enum.description: A tagged sum with a payload per variant, or none.

match.description: One arm per variant; there is no wildcard.

for.description: A sequential loop over lo..hi, evaluated once.

while.description: A loop while a condition holds.

parallel.description: A region: lane i touches only element [i] of what it writes.

reduce.description: A checked reduction over n elements.

spawn and wait.description: A task that leases what it borrows until wait.

defer.description: A call run at every normal exit of this block.

import.description: A module of the packaged library.

trait and impl.description: A trait with static dispatch, and an implementation for a record.

unsafe.description: The foreign boundary and the machine, never a way to silence the checker.
